text.p: Hollinger Inc and its subsidiary, Hollinger International Inc, said it intends to sweeten its offer for 7.0 million common shares of Southam Inc to C$20 per share.
Hollinger said in a statement that an independent committee of Southam directors intends to recommend the offer to Southam shareholders.
Hollinger's original offer was C$18.75 per share.

"The special committee... considering the offer has been advised by RBC Dominion Securities Inc that the $20 per share price is fair from a financial point of view and the Special Committee intends to recommend that Southam shareholders accept the offer," Hollinger said in a statement.
At the committee's request, Hollinger said it intends to vary its offer to limit its right to acquire more than 7.0 million Southam shares.
Hollinger said it agreed not to acquire more than 8.5 million Southam shares unless it met certain requirements, including notifying Southam shareholders.

Hollinger also agreed that shareholders would have 10 days to deposit their shares after receiving notice. Southam shareholders would also have the right to withdraw shares deposited during that 10-day period.
Hollinger said a notice of variation regarding the sweetened offer would be mailed to Southam shareholders on or about November 15.
Hollinger, which holds 41 percent of Southam, launched the bid for a majority stake in the newspaper chain last month.
